title: Post in Cedar Ford Neighbors: "Whole South Side Out by Midnight"

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her fifties with short gray hair, smiling, selfie on a front porch in a small Iowa town
fields.text:
Just got this from a deputy friend. PLEASE SHARE!!!

"WHOLE SOUTH SIDE has to be out by midnight, levee can't take 23 feet. Everybody behind the levee GO. Schools closed all week."

They're not telling us this on the news yet. Don't wait for the sirens, pack up NOW. #CedarFordFlood #TallisCounty
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone screenshot of a text message conversation, contact name shown only as 'Mike (work)', gray text bubble with the all-caps evacuation message, time 2:11 PM at top, battery at 34 percent

comments.author: Tallis Valley Radio
comments.text: We're live at 3:00. Tallis County EMA: is this the whole south side or just Cedar Hollow, and is it voluntary or mandatory? We have the noon Weather Service product saying 23.4 ft and major. Need an answer before air.

comments.author: Brent O.
comments.text: I run a shop on Front Street. Do we close tomorrow or not?? Called the county twice and I'm still on hold.

comments.author: Jessie M.
comments.text: This exact text is all over the Tallis Elementary parent thread. Nobody from the school has said anything about closing all week. Is it real?

instructorNote: Misinformation inject. The PIO should log the rumor and answer it within 20 minutes (SFMECS 8). The answer should say that Cedar Hollow is the area of concern and that the 340 homes behind the levee are not under an order, based only on what the Levee Superintendent has confirmed. It should cite the 12:00 Wednesday crest (MAJOR, raised from the previous issuance) and check that the county, city, Levee District and Red Cross messages agree. Hand this page to the PIO at 14:24 game time. Then deliver the 14:29 Tallis Valley Radio phone slip ("south side or just Cedar Hollow, voluntary or mandatory? Live at 15:00") as a separate slip. Watch whether the PIO pre-drafts a Cedar Hollow-polygon TallisAlert instead of sending a county-wide message, and saves the WEA for an actual order.
